sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Good afternoon
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 下午好。

sentences.en: Can help you?
sentences.zh: 需要帮忙吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT Good afternoon
sentences.zh: STUDENT 下午好。

sentences.en: Yes, I've just transferred to the School of Education, and I'd like information about joining the library
sentences.zh: 是的，我刚转入教育学院，想了解如何加入图书馆。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Well, the School of Education has libraries on two sites, as I'm sure you know
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 嗯，教育学院在两个地点设有图书馆，我想您应该已经知道这一点。

sentences.en: This one here is the Fordham Site, and the other is on Castle Road
sentences.zh: 这里这个是福特汉姆馆，另一个在城堡路。

sentences.en: STUDENT: And is there any difference between the two libraries?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 这两家图书馆有什么区别吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Not in terms of their facilities
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 就设施而言，并无区别。

sentences.en: Access to online databases and the Internct is available at both sites and cach site has a range of reference 021 materials on education
sentences.zh: 两个馆均提供在线数据库和互联网访问服务，且各馆均收藏有涵盖教育领域的各类参考文献资料。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Oh yes. see
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 哦，是的，我明白了。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: But the Castle Road site has books on the sociology of education and a collection of textbooks and teaching resources covering most of the subjects taught in secondary schools
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 但城堡路馆藏有教育社会学方面的书籍，以及一套覆盖中学各主要学科的教材与教学资源。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Ah, right, but I'm training to be a primary teacher so need to look at materials for the five to eleven age group
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 啊，明白了。不过我正接受小学教师培训，因此需要查阅面向5至11岁年龄段学生的教学资料。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Then you've come to the right place
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 那您来对地方了。

sentences.en: At Fordham we hold material relating to primary education, as well as special needs, but of course you'll need to familiarise yourself with both sites to make the most of our resources
sentences.zh: 福特汉姆馆收藏有关于初等教育及特殊教育需求的资料；当然，为了最大限度地利用我们的资源，您仍需熟悉两个馆点。

sentences.en: STUDENT: You haven't mentioned periodicals
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 您还没提到期刊。

sentences.en: Are they held at both sites?
sentences.zh: 期刊在两个馆点都有收藏吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Current issues, yes but if you want to look at back issues you'll need to use the CD-ROM databases which are held here at Fordham
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 最新期刊是的，但若要查阅过刊，则需使用存放于福特汉姆馆的CD-ROM数据库。

sentences.en: STUDENT: I sce
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Now, about borrowing books
sentences.zh: 那么，关于图书借阅事宜。

sentences.en: I'm living out of town, so I'm hoping can borrow quite a few items, and cut down on the number of trips have to make
sentences.zh: 我住在城外，所以希望可以多借几本书，从而减少往返次数。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Right, well, members can borrow two books at a time from each site
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 好的，会员每次可从每个馆点各借两本书。

sentences.en: + S A9
sentences.zh: 录音稿 + S A9

sentences.en: STUDENT: Only two books?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 只能借两本书？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Only two from each site, but that's four altogether
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 每个馆点最多只能借两本，但加起来总共是四本。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Oh I sce, and how long can I hang on to them for?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 哦，我明白了。那我可以借多久呢？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: The borrowing period is one month, but of course books can be renewed
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 借阅期限为一个月，当然图书可以续借。

sentences.en: You can renew any item a maximum of three times
sentences.zh: 任何图书最多可续借三次。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Do I have to come to the library to do that?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我必须亲自到图书馆办理续借手续吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: No, you can do it by telephone or cmail, but you can't renew overdue books this way, only before or on the due date stamped in the book
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 不必，您可通过电话或电子邮件办理，但这种方式仅适用于在到期日（即书内所盖日期）当天或之前续借；逾期图书无法通过此方式续借。

sentences.en: We'll need your full name, your borrower number and the name of the site library you borrowed the items from
sentences.zh: 我们需要您的全名、借阅者编号，以及您借书所在馆点的名称。

sentences.en: STUDENT: So theoretically can borrow books for up to three months is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 那么理论上，我最多可以借阅图书三个月，是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Yes, provided they're not recalled
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 是的，前提是这些图书未被其他读者召回。

sentences.en: STUDENT: So, what happens then?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 那如果被召回会怎样？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Well, sometimes an item is requested by another borrower, in which case we'd send you a letter, and you'd have to return the book within seven working days
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 嗯，有时某本书会被其他借阅者预约，此时我们会给您寄信通知，您须在七个正常工作日内归还该书。

sentences.en: Don't forget we're closed on Sundays
sentences.zh: 别忘了我们周日闭馆。

sentences.en: STUDENT: OK
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 好的。

sentences.en: STUDENT: I expect it'll take me a while to find what I need
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我估计找到所需资料得花些时间。

sentences.en: There's such lot here
sentences.zh: 这里的资料实在太多了。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Yes there is, but if you need help getting started, this term we're running three study skills workshops
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 的确如此，但若您需要入门指导，本学期我们正举办三场学习技能工作坊。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Oh?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 哦？

sentences.en: What are they on?
sentences.zh: 它们的主题是什么？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Er, let me see
sentences.zh: 图书管理员：呃，让我看看。

sentences.en: The first one's on resources - yes, here it is. it How to use the library's resources
sentences.zh: 第一个主题是资源——对，就在这里。题目是《如何使用图书馆的资源》。

sentences.en: That includes everything, not 028 just the print and technical resources
sentences.zh: 这涵盖了所有资源，而不仅仅是印刷类和技术类资源。

sentences.en: STUDENT: That sounds useful
sentences.zh: 学生：听起来很有用。

sentences.en: Is there anything on using the Internet?
sentences.zh: 有关于使用互联网的课程吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Er, let's see
sentences.zh: 图书管理员：呃，我们来看看。

sentences.en: The one on the Internet for beginners was last term
sentences.zh: 面向初学者的互联网使用课程是上学期开设的。

sentences.en: This 028 term it's finding research materials online
sentences.zh: 本学期（028 ）的课程主题是在线查找研究资料。

sentences.en: STUDENT: That sounds interesting too, hm, what's the last one?
sentences.zh: 学生：这个听起来也很有趣。嗯，最后一个主题是什么呢？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: It's a workshop on dissertations
sentences.zh: 图书管理员：这是一个关于学位论文的研讨会。

sentences.en: STUDENT: What do you mean -how to write one?
sentences.zh: 学生：您是指如何撰写学位论文吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Er. no it's more to do with academic writing conventions, you know writing a bibliography and how to refer to sources in your text
sentences.zh: 图书管理员：呃，不是的，它更多涉及学术写作规范，比如如何编写参考文献目录，以及如何在正文中引用资料来源。

sentences.en: That sort of thing
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的内容。

sentences.en: Anyway, here's a leaflet with information about all three
sentences.zh: 总之，这是介绍这三门课程信息的宣传单。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Thanks a lot
sentences.zh: 学生：非常感谢！

sentences.en: That'll be very useful
sentences.zh: 这将非常有用。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: You're welcome
sentences.zh: 图书管理员：不客气。
